flags: Cabinet designation specifies KY 8 through Augusta, with no mileage or scenic rationale. Catalog maps a wider Foster–Dover corridor. Overview separates designated Augusta from the wider approach and continuation; exact legal endpoints remain unresolved.
Cache offers river alignment but no supported drive time, curves, grades or road-construction narrative. History therefore addresses the commemorative name and documented designation.

Mary Ingles accounts disagree on details and journey distance. Omitted the current grape-gathering, non-swimming and 145-crossings details despite their presence in the secondary cache; no direct primary text for those specific claims is saved. No claim that modern KY 8 precisely retraces her journey.

Ferry continuity since 1797 and sole-public-crossing status appear in the secondary cache, but no current operator page verifies service or access. Replaced current operating guarantee with historical origins and geography; ferry moment is intentionally short.
Dover moment is short because supported place history is thin. New coordinates copied from cache/06.txt. Current story and moments have no motifs fields; empty story motifs supplied.
